title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: supervisors can edit and override submitted quality evaluations
summary: The briefing passes: the editing workflow, required privileges, automation calls and consumption-based licensing are supported. The role-assignment guidance should clarify that the user screen manages direct assignments only, and the override-monitoring checklist has no corresponding control row.

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 Customer Service supervisors and Quality Managers can modify submitted evaluation results.
claims.quote: This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired.
